description:
Explore the worlds you build and the stories you play. Atlavium connects ChatGPT to the knowledge in your Atlavium, helping worldbuilders, game masters, and players work with their own notes and sources.

For worldbuilders, bring together lore about people, places, and factions, trace recorded relationships and world events, and revisit your setting's history. Compare source passages as you develop an idea, or calculate dates using your world's own calendar. Your existing lore gives you a starting point for what comes next.

Game masters can prepare a session from relevant locations, characters, past events, and open quests, then look up the details they need during play. Players can revisit their character journals, recall encounters, and follow the people and places that matter to their character's story.

Choose a Realm and ask questions in English or German. Search its Compendium, read relevant passages, summarize documents or session recaps, and explore recorded connections in the World Graph. Answers can link back to the original Atlavium sources so you can check what is established, where accounts differ, and what remains an open question.

Connect your Atlavium account and approve access to get started. The plugin reads content your account can access within the selected Realm. Ideas and drafts stay in the conversation until you choose to add them in Atlavium. You decide what becomes Canon.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my last session and highlight unresolved quests and questions for the next game.
Help me trace the recorded connections between two characters, places, or factions in my world.
What do my notes reveal about the history of a place or faction in my world?
